_purpose: Example 'Analysis Profile' upload -- this is the file the Analysis page reads. Each entry is a plain-English requirement, not a structured pivot spec: the Analysis Agent's own Think step works out the group-by/aggregation logic itself (see analysis_definitions_store.py). Nothing is computed until a file like this is uploaded to that slot; there is no backend default. 'input_columns' is just a hint of which columns the analysis is likely to use -- edit freely and re-upload.

analyses.name: Shipments by Product & Origin
analyses.description: Counts shipments grouped by Product then by Origin -- answers 'how many shipments per product, and which origin shipped them.'
analyses.calculation_intent: Count shipments grouped by Product and then by Origin, showing how many shipments came from each origin for every product.

analyses.name: Carrier Compliance Ranking
analyses.description: All carriers ranked by shipment volume, with average % In Spec alongside -- answers 'which carrier is worst for compliance.'
analyses.calculation_intent: Rank every carrier by shipment volume (count of Serial Number), showing the average % In Spec alongside the shipment count for each carrier, sorted by shipment count descending.

analyses.name: Monthly Compliance Trend
analyses.description: % In Spec and shipment volume by arrival month -- answers 'is compliance improving or worsening as the season/volume ramps up.'
analyses.calculation_intent: Show average % In Spec and shipment volume (count of Serial Number) grouped by Arrival Month, sorted chronologically, as a trend over the season.

analyses.name: Shipment Mix by Mode of Transportation
analyses.description: What share of shipments moved by each transportation mode.
analyses.calculation_intent: Show the count of shipments and the percentage share of total shipments for each Mode Of Transportation.
